case.summary: A digital residential showcase with apartment discovery, filters, and detailed property-selection flows.

narrative.title: Task
narrative.text: Build a content-rich residential product showcase and connect its presentation layer to a clear apartment-selection journey.

narrative.title: My contribution
narrative.text: I developed the homepage and complex content sections, property filters, apartment detail page, masterplan, and animated interface scenarios.

narrative.title: Technical approach
narrative.text: A component architecture with Vue and Nuxt, typed filtering logic, controlled GSAP animation, and focused performance work for visually heavy sections.

narrative.title: Result
narrative.text: A working product journey from project discovery to filtering and reviewing a specific apartment, available on the public website.

projects.description: Catalog, filters, and product cards optimized for speed and easy selection.

bullets: Designed a three-level property filter (phase → building → section) in a typed reusable composable, reducing invalid UI states.
Built a shared mortgage and installment calculator with typed API adapters instead of duplicated implementations.
Consolidated account functionality from two repositories, improved authentication flows and standardized a 14,000-city directory.
Optimized data fetching and legacy Vue/Nuxt modules; selected pages became 15–40% faster.
Contributed to task breakdown, code review, and an interactive property map with GSAP animations.
Helped migrate modules from Vue 2 to Vue 3 and TypeScript, adopting Composition API.
Reduced the loading time of a key furniture e-commerce screen from roughly 5 to 2 seconds using lazy loading and Intersection Observer.
Used Cypress for E2E coverage and Vitest for unit and component tests of critical user flows.
Built catalogs, product details, carts, REST API integrations, maps and animated UI components.
Contributed to code review and legacy refactoring in collaboration with backend developers, designers and QA.

aiEngineering.title: AI-assisted Engineering
aiEngineering.subtitle: I use AI agents to support engineering work, not to replace architecture, review or ownership.
aiEngineering.lead: I work with Claude Code and OpenAI Codex: defining tasks, setting context and acceptance criteria, reviewing solutions and taking responsibility for the final code.

steps.title: Architecture & decomposition
steps.description: Before implementation, I define module boundaries, data contracts, dependencies, constraints and acceptance criteria so agents work within clear engineering guardrails.

steps.title: Agent Harnesses
steps.description: I set up project instructions, context, tools and validation steps for agent workflows, focusing on predictable outcomes rather than generated code volume.

steps.title: Reviewer Skills & code review
steps.description: I create custom reviewer skills for agents and check type safety, error handling, edge cases, testability and unnecessary abstractions.

aiEngineering.qualityText: I do not accept AI-generated code without independent review. Correctness, readability and maintainability come first; I apply KISS, DRY, YAGNI and SOLID pragmatically.
